_comment: Recorded column manifest for Preview system.* tables used by the four Preview query packs. This is the CI baseline — it must be kept in sync with actual table schemas. To refresh from a live workspace, run a LIMIT 0 probe against each table and capture the column names, e.g.: SELECT * FROM <table> LIMIT 0. See docs/discovery/preview_pack_schema_guard.md for the full refresh procedure.
